 IF NOT ID_NULL(pl_id) THEN
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);

 message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name);

 END IF;
 run_other_form(lower('UTQALERT'),'X',pl_id);

end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_SUPPLEMENTAL_DRIVE_DATA IS
 /* This used to be post - query on drives */
 v_staff_no varchar2(6) ;
 cursor c1 is 
 select resource_type, sum(number_reqd)number_reqd
 from drive_estimated_resources der, valid_resources vr
 where der.drive_id = :drive_id
 and der.resource_code = vr.resource_code
 group by resource_type;
 ------------------------------------------------------------------
 FUNCTION select_max (p_resource in varchar2) return number IS
 cursor c1 is 
 select drive_id, sum(number_reqd)number_reqd
 from drive_estimated_resources der, valid_resources vr
 where der.drive_id = :drive_id
 and der.resource_code = vr.resource_code
 and vr.resource_type = p_resource
 group by drive_id;
 max_req number(4) := 0;
 BEGIN
 FOR max_c in C1
 LOOP
 IF max_req < max_c.number_reqd THEN
 max_req := max_c.number_reqd;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 return max_req;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END; 
begin
 begin
 select sponsor_id,initcap(name) into :det_drives.sponsor_id,:det_drives.sponsor_name from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = 
 (select sponsor_id from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = :det_drives.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1 )
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ; 
 end; 
 IF nvl(:det_drives.piggy, 'NULL') = 'P' THEN
 IF not (nvl(:GLOBAL.dg_id, 'NULL') = :DET_DRIVES.drive_group_id) THEN
 :GLOBAL.dg_id := :DET_DRIVES.drive_group_id;
 :staff_req := select_max('STAFF');

 ------- Following added to get MAX #staff out of two piggybacked drives ----- MG 7/6/99
 declare
 cursor cp is
 select drive_id
 from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type = 'PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = :det_drives.drive_group_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 l_staff number;
 begin
 for cp_rec in cp
 loop
 select number_reqd into l_staff
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id = cp_rec.drive_id
 and resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 if l_staff > :staff_req then
 :staff_req := l_staff;
 end if;
 end loop;
 end;
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 :van_req := select_max('VAN');
 :coach_req := select_max('COACH');
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 if c1rec.resource_type = 'STAFF' then
 :staff_req := c1rec.number_reqd ;
 elsif c1rec.resource_type = 'VAN' then
 :van_req := c1rec.number_reqd ;
 elsif c1rec.resource_type = 'COACH' then
 :coach_req := c1rec.number_reqd ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;
 if :staff_req is null then
 :staff_req := 0 ;
 end if ;
 if :van_req is null then
 :van_req := 0 ;
 end if ;
 if :coach_req is null then
 :coach_req := 0 ;
 end if ;
 END IF;
 begin
 select description into :drive_type_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'DRVTY'
 and code = :drive_type ;
 exception
 when others then null ;
 end ;
 begin
 select substr(initcap(first_name)||' '||initcap(last_name),1,50)
 into :recruiter_name
 from employees
 where staff_no = :recruiter_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then null ;
 end ;
 begin
 select df.facility_code into :det_drives.facility_code
 from drives dr, drive_facilities df
 where dr.drive_id = df.drive_id
 and dr.drive_id = :det_drives.drive_id
 and dr.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 end;
 :det_drives.drive_times := to_char(:det_drives.schedule_start_time,'HH24:MI')||'-'||to_char(:det_drives.schedule_end_time,'HH24:MI');
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DRIVES_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Get_Drives_Data IS
 Cursor g_d_data is 
 SELECT d.drive_id drive_id,
 decode(dg.drive_group_id,null,null,'P') piggy,
 d.drive_type drive_type,
 d.projected_draw projected_draw,
 d.projected_show projected_show,
 d.drive_date drive_date,
 d.schedule_start_time schedule_start_time,
 d.schedule_end_time schedule_end_time, 
 d.recruiter_id recruiter_id,
 d.location_id location_id, 
 dg.drive_group_id drive_group_id,
 d.drive_category 
 from drives d, drive_groups dg, drive_facilities df 
 where d.drive_id = dg.drive_id (+)
 and drive_group_type(+) = 'PIGGY'
 and cancel_date is null 
 and d.drive_id = df.drive_id(+)
 and nvl(df.facility_code,'X') = decode(:ddate.facility,null,nvl(facility_code,'X'),:ddate.facility)
 and drive_date = :ddate.ddate
 and d.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and status != 'CANCL'
 and ((drive_type in ('C','I')
 and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'MOB')
 or 
 (drive_type = 'F' 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'FIX')
 or
 (drive_type = drive_type
 and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'BOTH')
 )
 order by dg.drive_group_id, d.schedule_start_time;
 ctr number(4) := 0;
BEGIN
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 :GLOBAL.dg_id := null;
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'BUSY');
 go_block('DET_DRIVES');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 --pitss synchronize;
 for c1 in g_d_data 
 loop
 ctr := ctr + 1;
 :DET_DRIVES.drive_id := c1.drive_id;
 :DET_DRIVES.piggy := c1.piggy;
 :DET_DRIVES.projected_draw := c1.projected_draw;
 :DET_DRIVES.schedule_start_time := c1.schedule_start_time;
 :DET_DRIVES.schedule_end_time := c1.schedule_end_time;
 :DET_DRIVES.recruiter_id := c1.recruiter_id;
 :DET_DRIVES.drive_type := c1.drive_type;
 :DET_DRIVES.drive_group_id := c1.drive_group_id;
 :DET_DRIVES.rownum := ctr;
 get_supplemental_drive_data;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 clear_message; 
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT');
 --pitss synchronize;
 erase('GLOBAL.dg_id');
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 v_where varchar2(200);
 v_temp varchar2(50);
 v_drv_typ varchar2(1);
 cursor C1 is
 SELECT drive_date, count(drive_id) num_drv, 
 to_char(drive_date,'Day') drv_day,
 sum(projected_draw) tot_draw,
 sum(projected_show) tot_show
 FROM drives
 WHERE drive_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date 
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND status != 'CANCL'
 AND (
 (drive_type in ('C','I') and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'MOB')
 or(drive_type = 'F' and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'FIX')
 or(drive_type = drive_type and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'BOTH')
 )
 GROUP BY drive_date
 ORDER BY drive_date;
begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date := :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date + 6;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date < :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date then
 show_error('0073');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'BUSY');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);--pitss synchronize;
 go_block('drives');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 for sel in C1
 loop
 :drives.drive_date := sel.drive_date;
 :drives.drive_day := sel.drive_date;
 :drives.no_drives := sel.num_drv;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type = 'AL' or :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type is null THEN
 :drives.projected_show := sel.tot_show;
 :drives.projected_draw := sel.tot_draw;
 RETRIEVE_GOALS; 
 END IF;
 RETRIEVE_ACTUALS; 
 RETRIEVE_VENI_CODE_TOTALS;
 RETRIEVE_PRELAB;
 RETRIEVE_RNFT; 
 if :drives.projected_show > 0 then
 :drives.deferral_percent := 100 * (:drives.projected_show - :drives.projected_draw) / :drives.projected_show;
 else
 :drives.projected_show := 0;
 end if;
 if :drives.act_draw > 0 or :drives.act_dfrl > 0 then
 :drives.per_act_def := 100 * :drives.act_dfrl / (:drives.act_draw + :drives.act_dfrl) ;
 else
 :drives.per_act_def := 0;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 first_record;
 IF :drives.drive_date is null THEN
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 show_error('9188');
 ELSE
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_don_lov',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type',enabled,property_false);
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.fixsite','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_drive_dtl','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_date_stat','E'); 
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.pb_site_stat','E'); 
 END IF;
 clear_message;
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT');
 if :ctrl_blk_2.sum_p_show > 0 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.percent_dfrl := 100*(:ctrl_blk_2.sum_p_show - :ctrl_blk_2.sum_p_draw) / :ctrl_blk_2.sum_p_show;
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.percent_dfrl := 0;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.sum_actl_dfrl > 0 or :ctrl_blk_2.sum_actl_draw > 0 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.act_dfrl_percent := 100*(:ctrl_blk_2.sum_actl_dfrl/(:ctrl_blk_2.sum_actl_dfrl + :ctrl_blk_2.sum_actl_draw));
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.act_dfrl_percent := 0;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_ACTUALS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RETRIEVE_ACTUALS IS
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(count(unit_id)) INTO :drives.act_draw
 FROM donations
 WHERE drive_id in (SELECT drive_id 
 FROM DRIVES 
 WHERE DRIVE_DATE = :DRIVES.DRIVE_DATE
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND status != 'CANCL'
 AND (
 (drive_type in ('C','I') and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'MOB')
 or(drive_type = 'F' and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'FIX')
 or(drive_type = drive_type and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'BOTH')
 )
 )
 AND unit_id IS NOT NULL
 AND donation_type = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type,null,donation_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type)
 GROUP BY DRIVE_ID
 ORDER BY DRIVE_ID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT sum(count(*)) INTO :drives.act_dfrl
 FROM donations
 WHERE drive_id in (SELECT drive_id 
 FROM DRIVES 
 WHERE DRIVE_DATE = :DRIVES.DRIVE_DATE
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND status != 'CANCL'
 AND (
 (drive_type in ('C','I') and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'MOB')
 or(drive_type = 'F' and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'FIX')
 or(drive_type = drive_type and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'BOTH')
 )
 )
 AND unit_id IS NULL
 AND donation_type = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type,null,donation_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type)
 GROUP BY DRIVE_ID
 ORDER BY DRIVE_ID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
 END;
END;

FUNCTION CALC_VENI_CODES(p_code in varchar2) RETURN NUMBER IS
 temp_count number(4) := 0;

 select count('x') into temp_count
 from donation_attributes
 where attrib_code = 'VENI'
 and attrib_value = p_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id

 (select transaction_id

 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and donation_type = decode(:ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type,null,donation_type,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type)
 and drive_id in 
 (select drive_id 
 from drives
 where drive_date = :drives.drive_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and status != 'CANCL'
 and ( 
 (drive_type in ('C','I') and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'MOB')
 or(drive_type = 'F' and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'FIX')
 or(drive_type = drive_type and :ctrl_blk_1.fixsite = 'BOTH')
 )
 )
 );
 return temp_count;
exception
 when others THEN

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_format varchar2(100); 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026, 50025)
 then -- 50025 added by MG on 02/11
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then 
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
message('muk 2');
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
